svg.text: Dashed arrow = dependency (uses). Hollow triangle = inheritance (generalization).
Inheritance (triangle toward parent). PolicyManager uses a bent path in the gutter so it does not cross UserController.
Dependency (dashed, open arrow). PHIDetectionService→PHIDetector runs in the left margin, not through other Python classes.

text.tspan: Visibility: + public | - private | # protected. Logical layers only, not every framework class.
